cards.text: Jesus is still teaching His disciples about His coming (Matthew 24:3), and now He tells a story. The kingdom of heaven, He says, will be like ten virgins who take their lamps and go out to meet the bridegroom. Ten lamps, one bridegroom, and a WEDDING on the way!

cards.question: Jesus says the ten virgins aren't all alike. Five of them are foolish, and five are ___.
All ten virgins take their lamps. But the foolish ones leave something behind. What don't they take along?

cards.text: But the wise ones take oil in flasks along with their lamps. That's the person who packs a spare tire AND actually checks the air in it.
Then the bridegroom is delayed. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, and by the end I was counting the dust as it fell and getting EXCITED when a big one came down.

cards.question: While the bridegroom is delayed, only the foolish virgins get drowsy and fall asleep.

cards.text: Then at MIDNIGHT the cry rings out: "Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!" That's the doorbell ringing ten minutes after you FINALLY fell asleep on the couch.

cards.question: When the cry rings out, the foolish virgins sleep right through it.

cards.text: All ten trim their lamps, and the foolish five turn to the wise five: "Give us some of your oil…" That's asking to borrow a pen five minutes into the big meeting.

cards.question: The foolish virgins ask the wise ones for some of their oil. Why do the foolish ones need it?

answers.text: They spilled theirs on the road

cards.question: The wise virgins agree to share some of their oil with the foolish ones.
The wise virgins say no to sharing their oil. What reason do they give?

answers.text: There may not be enough for both
The bridegroom told them not to
They plan to sell it later

cards.question: Instead, the wise virgins tell the foolish ones to go to those who sell oil and buy some for themselves.

cards.text: So the foolish five head off to buy oil. That's driving across town for a charger with your phone at two percent and the map still running.

cards.question: The bridegroom waits for the foolish virgins to get back with their oil before he goes in to the wedding banquet.
While the foolish virgins are away, those who are ready go in with the bridegroom to the wedding banquet, and the door is ___.

cards.text: Later the other virgins arrive and call out, "Lord, lord, open the door for us!" That's locking yourself out of the house and knocking, hoping SOMEBODY in there hears you.

cards.question: The foolish virgins are outside the shut door, asking to be let in. What does the bridegroom reply?
Jesus ends the story by saying to keep watch. Why?

answers.text: You do not know the day or the hour
The bridegroom always comes at midnight
The night is almost over now

cards.text: Jesus isn't finished teaching His disciples, friend. Stick close, because this teaching isn't done yet.
